issue.title: Allow multi-character corners on borders
issue.body:
**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
I am trying to make borders with the following style: 
```
  ┌──                                             ── ┐                                                                                                        
  │                                                  │                                                    
                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                              
  │                                                  │                                                                                                    
  └──                                              ──┘    
```

**Describe the solution you'd like**
Multi-character corner support for lipgloss.Border (it currently truncates corners to 1 rune)

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
Manual border rendering

**Additional context**
